title: Schindler 2.0 Control Catalog — v0.1.0
description: Inventory of all operator-tunable controls + read-only status on the iter5-1080p-clean substrate as of 2026-05-31. Sourced from sw/phase-b/src/main.c UART command handlers + iter14 kernel-mode toggle + Mackin alpha. This catalog is the single source of truth that the schindlerd daemon, web UI, and RP2040 front-panel firmware all generate code from. Future catalog versions add controls as features land; semver applies (patch = bug, minor = add, major = remove/rename/retype).

categories.title: Color
categories.description: Saturation, per-channel level (black/white), and 3×3 matrix transforms applied between MM2S and axis_to_vid_io.

categories.title: Scaler
categories.description: iter14 runtime kernel-mode selection for the H and V downscalers. Production default = 2-tap boxcar; NN sharpens at cost of dropped cols/rows; 4-tap softens.

categories.title: FRC
categories.description: Mackin alpha for temporal blending (Phase E2 — wiring is currently placeholder; alpha will be load-bearing once dual-VDMA wiring lands).

categories.title: Status
categories.description: Read-only telemetry exposed via DIAG print. v0.1.0 lists the ones the daemon needs to subscribe to for the operator status bar; future versions add more granular metrics.

controls.title: Saturation
controls.notes: 0 = grayscale; 100 = identity; 200 = roughly 2× chroma. Implements Rec.601 luma-mix saturation.

controls.title: Matrix Saturation
controls.axi_gpio_register: axi_gpio_4/5/6 (3×3 matrix coefficients derived from sat percent)
controls.notes: Alternative saturation via the full 3×3 matrix path instead of the luma-mix shortcut. 0 = grayscale, 100 = identity. Setting either color.saturation or this overrides the matrix; cannot be used simultaneously.

controls.title: Color matrix preset
controls.notes: Identity zeros out matrix saturation; grayscale forces it to 0. Custom mode preserves the matrix state set by color.matrix_saturation or future custom 9-coefficient + 3-offset writes.

controls.title: Mackin temporal blend alpha
controls.notes: 0x8000 = use current frame only (no blend, equivalent to drop/repeat). 0x4000 = 50/50 blend of current and previous frames. 0x0000 = use previous frame only. CURRENT STATE: bench wiring is placeholder axis_clone — both VDMA paths feed the same frame so alpha has no visible effect until dual-VDMA wiring lands.

controls.title: Reset to defaults
controls.notes: Identity color matrix, sat=100%, black=(0,0,0), white=(255,255,255). Does NOT reset scaler kernel modes (those persist until explicitly changed).

controls.title: Print help
controls.notes: UART-only — surface=[] means it doesn't appear in operator UIs.

controls.title: Source HDMI lock
controls.notes: Drives the operator status bar 'source present' indicator.

controls.title: Source format
controls.source: VTC_RX DASIZE + DVSIZE + DTSTAT (rate derived from HTOTAL × VTOTAL × pclk)

profile_format.description: A profile is a JSON object mapping control IDs to their values. Loaded by control.batch_set in one atomic apply.

open_questions: Should 'system.help' and 'system.readback' be in the catalog at all, or are they UART-only meta and excluded from the operator-surface schema? Currently included with surface=[] to mark them as 'exists but not for UIs'.

Catalog hot-reload: if the daemon re-reads catalog.json mid-flight, do clients need a version handshake to re-sync? Currently the design freezes catalog at daemon start; firmware updates restart the daemon (cleaner).

Per-channel matrix coefficients (m00..m22) — should they be individual controls (12 entries) or one composite '3×3 matrix' control with structured value type? v0.1.0 hides them behind matrix.preset for now; advanced UI in v2.

next_catalog_versions.0.2.0: Add FRC method auto-selection control (frc.method = A/B/C/D/E auto/manual) once Methods B/C/E ship.
next_catalog_versions.0.3.0: Add Phase G analog output controls (ntsc cadence, chip mute, etc.) when ADV7393 chip arrives.
next_catalog_versions.0.4.0: Add iter14 mode 3 = polyphase MAC if/when that ships.
